sentences.en: Towel racks, shower heads, and toilet-roll holders are bathroom accessories.
sentences.zh: 毛巾架、淋浴头和卫生纸架是浴室配件。

sentences.en: That glittering accessory doesn't go with your sweatshirt. Try this on!
sentences.zh: 那件闪闪发光的配饰和你的卫衣不太搭。试试这件吧！

sentences.en: Accessories were laid out on the shelf for sale.
sentences.zh: 货架上摆放着各种可供出售的配件。

senses.zh: 配件，附件；装饰品；从犯，同谋
